description.value:
Duration while the duel lasts

Your marked target cannot leave the encounter while you are both conscious: it cannot teleport, flee beyond 120 feet of you, become invisible to you, or be removed from the battlefield by any effect of your level or lower. Your Strikes against it ignore all resistance and all immunity to precision damage.

cinderfall.incomplete: The mark can't leave the encounter (no teleport, no fleeing past 120 feet, no invisibility to the caster, no removal by an effect at or below the caster's level) while both are conscious; Strikes against it ignore all resistance and precision immunity. No selector restricts a different creature's own movement/escape options or removes their immunities -- compounded by the confirmed-unfireable mark predicate.
